notes: 2024 Regional Development Concept (legalinfo.mn, item 3.2.12 'Ховд хотод бүсийн дата төв байгуулна') mandates a regional data center in Khovd city (Jargalant sum, Hovd aimag), the western-belt regional hub. Policy-level only: no named site, developer, MW, or permit yet. This is the regional capital DC plan, not a facility.
